description: A fictional primary airport surface-surveillance capture. Runway, taxiway and apron geometry are authored context; moving returns are not automatically classified or identified.

synthesis.timeline: Twenty-four 4-second rotating scans, 180 azimuth centers at 2-degree intervals and 64 horizontal range centers at 25+50r metres. Main samples evaluated at dwell midpoint. Eight target-free reference scans precede the main capture.
synthesis.targetModel: Surface A:E=700,N=-1100+22t; surface B:E=-850+9t,N=300; surface C:E=-900,N=-400+8t through 87.5 seconds, then E=-900+8(t-87.5),N=300. All positions in a horizontal surface plane; no climb, landing guidance or aircraft-identity claim.
synthesis.beam: Gaussian power response sigma 1 degree, FWHM 2.354820045 degrees; range response sigma 36 m. Physical range, angular resolution and RF performance are not calibrated.
synthesis.reference: Independent reference seed and target-free source acquisition. The same static authored background appears in reference and main captures, with independent uniform [0.96,1.04] multiplicative texture and independent exponential noise mean 0.055 plus floor 0.025.
synthesis.background: Gaussian static components: E-1250,N900,gain 7,angular sigma 5 degrees,range sigma100 m; E100,N-650,gain 5,sigma 12 degrees/110 m; E-1320,N100,gain 3.6,sigma 14 degrees/160 m.
synthesis.attenuation: Surface A gain 4.3; surface B gain 3.3 falls to 0.008 in scans 9–11; surface C gain 2.9. Prescribed source fading, not an operational coverage claim.
synthesis.transient: A gain 1.9 transient at bearing 240 degrees/range 2100 m during scan 5 is absent from the reference capture. It therefore survives static subtraction and is treated like any other return.
synthesis.truth: Separate scenario coordinates at every dwell end. Background estimation, detector policy, detection and tracking never consume these rows or target labels.

preprocessing.background: At each azimuth/range cell, arithmetic mean of the eight retained float32 reference samples, rounded to float32 once. No truth or target position is used.
preprocessing.residual: For every main source cell, float32(max(0,rawPower-backgroundPower)). The raw capture remains retained. Negative residuals are clamped, not interpreted as missing measurements.
preprocessing.eligibility: Zero at cell centers within E[-1600,-1000],N[-600,700], an authored apron processing exclusion; one elsewhere. Raw apron reception is retained. This policy is a demonstration, not a recommendation for airport operations.

detector.threshold: max(0.6,4*mean(eligible training cells at range offsets -10..-3 and 3..10)). Boundaries clipped; if no eligible training cells exist, use 0.6. Not a calibrated CFAR false-alarm claim.
detector.peaks: Eligible centers only; retained residual power must meet threshold and be the maximum over eligible 3x3 azimuth/range neighbors. Azimuth wraps. Equal-power ties choose the lower storage index; first/last range bins excluded.
detector.localization: Exact retained horizontal range/azimuth cell center. No subcell interpolation or elevation inference.
detector.timing: Detection epoch is peak dwell midpoint. Neighboring azimuth processing requires the full scan; detections and tracks appear only at scan end.

tracker.measurement: Common horizontal detections only. Assumed independent sigma 60 m Cartesian errors; model confidence is not calibrated.
tracker.transition: Constant velocity. F=[[1,0,dt,0],[0,1,0,dt],[0,0,1,0],[0,0,0,1]]. Q=sigma_a² G Gᵀ, G=[[dt²/2,0],[0,dt²/2],[dt,0],[0,dt]], sigma_a = 1.5 m/s²; each propagation interval has independent assumed acceleration.
tracker.association: Detections processed by measurement time within a completed scan. Greedy minimum squared innovation Mahalanobis distance <= 9.21034. At most one detection per track per scan. Unassigned detections start new tracks; no scene identities or truth labels supplied.
tracker.initialization: Position from detection, zero velocity, covariance diag(3600,3600,900,900).
tracker.update: Linear Kalman update with Joseph covariance form. Export all active states at scan end. Confirmed after 3 total updates; any missed update gives coasting; retire after 4 consecutive misses. Confirmed is a filter bookkeeping state, not identification or verification.
tracker.uncertainty: 95% Gaussian region conditional on the declared filter and fixed horizontal frame. No physical location accuracy is certified.
tracker.fullCovariance: track-state.csv stores all 4 × 4 entries p00..p33 and hit/miss counters. Position-only covariance is in tracks.csv.

siteContext: site-features.csv contains authored static context in the same local horizontal frame. Structures, routes and exclusions are reference geometry, not measured radar contours. Labels do not classify detected objects.
exclusions: No terrain masking, multipath or atmosphere
No target identity or real-world capability claim
No blockage, terrain visibility, horizon, coverage-probability or detectability solution
No airborne approach, target height, secondary transponder report, multi-sensor fusion or airport certification
No real location, real airport layout or operational procedure
